independence: Separate primary-author agent; no inorganic decision/proposal authored or directly edited by reviewer. Reviewer challenged v1, requested corrections, and rereviewed exact v3 bytes. Shared captures are checked against source content and hashes, not independent experiments.
scope: All80 frozen source cases and all8 current proposals; source/form/alias safety only, not whole-record role or release approval. All full occurrences/raw records, current owner statuses, native review rows/holds and cited captures were inspected.
